name: Chronojet Dragon
kana: クロノジェット・ドラゴン
skillText:
[CONT](VC) Generation Break 2 (Active if you have two or more face up G units in total on your (VC) or G zone): When this unit attacks a vanguard, until end of that battle, this unit gets [Power]+5000, and your opponent cannot call grade 1 or greater cards from hand to (GC).
[AUTO](VC): When your G unit Stride during your turn, COST [Counter Blast (1)], choose one of your opponent's rear-guards, and put it on the bottom of their deck.
flavorText: A tale from a distant time. The gears of time began rotating with the dragon.

faqs.question: Can I use the on-stride Stride skill if my heart is Chronojet Dragon?
faqs.answer: Yes! The [AUTO] skill triggers when you Stride a G unit while Chronojet Dragon is on the Vanguard circle. You pay Counter Blast 1 to spin an opponent's rear-guard to the bottom of the deck.

faqs.question: Does Generation Break 2 activate when Chronojet restands after Chronodragon Nextage's attack?
faqs.answer: Yes! If you have two or more face-up G units in your G-Zone (Nextage turns face-up when it goes back to G-zone, plus any previously face-up G cards), GB2 is active for Chronojet's follow-up attack, giving it +5000 Power and locking grade 1+ guards from hand.

name: Smokegear Dragon
kana: スモークギア・ドラゴン
skillText: [AUTO]: When this unit is rode upon by a grade 3 with "Chronojet" in its card name, COST [Soul Blast (1)], search your deck for up to one grade 3 unit card, reveal it and put it into your hand, and shuffle your deck.
flavorText: It is said that countless futures were projected beyond the deeply fogged vision.

faqs.question: Can I search for G units with Smokegear's ride upon effect?
faqs.answer: No. G units are kept in your G-Zone, not inside your main deck. Smokegear searches your main deck for up to one grade 3 unit card (such as another Chronojet Dragon or Steam Fighter, Balih).

faqs.question: Is paying Soul Blast (1) mandatory for Smokegear Dragon?
faqs.answer: No, COST is optional. However, you must pay the Soul Blast (1) cost upon ride to search your deck for a grade 3 unit card.

name: Masergear Dragon
kana: メーザーギア・ドラゴン
skillText: [AUTO]: When this unit is placed by riding from "Chrono Dran", draw a card, and you get a "Chronojet Dragon" crest.
flavorText: A ray of light cuts through time and space, towards a distant future.

faqs.question: When do I get the Chronojet Dragon Crest?
faqs.answer: When Masergear Dragon is placed by riding from Chrono Dran (during your Grade 1 ride phase), you draw a card and put the "Chronojet Dragon" crest into your crest zone immediately.

name: Chrono Dran
kana: クロノ・ドラン
skillText: [AUTO]: When this unit is rode upon, if you went second, draw a card.
flavorText: Once upon a time, a certain young dragon opened the doors to a new world.

faqs.question: Does Chrono Dran go to the soul when ridden upon from the ride deck?
faqs.answer: Yes, standard ride deck rules apply: when Masergear Dragon is ridden over Chrono Dran, Chrono Dran moves to the soul, and if you went second, you draw a card.

name: Steam Fighter, Balih
kana: スチームファイター バリフ
skillText:
[CONT](RC) Generation Break 2 (Active if you have two or more face up G units in total on your (VC) or G zone): During your turn, if any player's rear-guard was put on the bottom of their deck this turn, this unit gets [Power]+10000.
[AUTO]: When this card is discarded from hand for the cost of Stride, draw a card.
flavorText: Protecting thy lord. The stories of a warrior's soul passed down through the ages.

faqs.question: How does Balih make Stride free in terms of card advantage?
faqs.answer: Discarding Balih alone satisfies the Stride cost (Grade 3), and Balih's AUTO immediately triggers to draw a card, making your Stride discard cost +0 in card economy!

name: Upstream Dragon
kana: アップストリーム・ドラゴン
skillText: [CONT](RC) Generation Break 1 (Active if you have one or more face up G units in total on your (VC) or G zone): When this unit attacks a vanguard, this unit gets [Power]+5000 until end of that battle. At the end of that battle, COST [put this unit on the bottom of your deck], search your deck for up to one grade 1 card, call it to a back row (RC), and shuffle your deck.
flavorText: Rewinding time, in search of an unexplored future.

faqs.question: Can I call Steam Scara, Gigi with Upstream Dragon?
faqs.answer: Yes! Upstream Dragon searches for any Grade 1 card and calls it to a back-row (RC). Calling Steam Scara, Gigi triggers Gigi's SB2 draw effect, cycling a card and gaining +5000 power.

faqs.question: Does Upstream Dragon return itself to the deck even if it gets guarded?
faqs.answer: Yes, the condition is "When this unit attacks a vanguard", not on hit. At the end of that battle, you may pay the cost to bottom-deck Upstream and tutor a Grade 1 to a back row (RC).

name: Steam Fighter, Argandia
kana: スチームファイター アルガンディア
skillText: [AUTO]: When this unit is put on (GC), COST [Soul Blast (1)], and this unit gets [Shield]+5000 until end of that battle. If you have a face up card in your G zone, this unit gets [Shield]+10000 instead of +5000.
flavorText: A long, long time ago, an observer of time from another world came to this planet.

faqs.question: How much Shield does Argandia provide when placed on (GC)?
faqs.answer: By paying Soul Blast (1), Argandia gains +5,000 Shield (10,000 total). If you have at least one face-up card in your G zone, it gains +10,000 Shield instead (15,000 total shield)!

faqs.question: Do I have to discard if Arlim is the only card in my hand?
faqs.answer: No! If you have only 1 card in hand (Arlim itself which was placed onto G), your remaining hand is 0 cards (< 2 cards), so no discard is required!

flavorText: The demonic dragon of fog followed. A journey through time, until the end.

faqs.question: Can I discard Steam Breath Dragon alone for Stride?
faqs.answer: Yes! Its continuous effect in hand allows it to count as a Grade 3 card when paying the Stride cost.

faqs.question: When does Gear Serow gain +5,000 Power?
